toolTaxonomy._epigraph: Tools are optional capabilities. Use them when they serve the current request.

chatgpt-anam-actions.description: On turns carried by the Anam ChatGPT bridge, discover and invoke configured Anam tools through the provided anam_action continuation route. This route requires Anam to carry the conversation.
notes: Discover the exact Anam server and schema through an <anam_action> discover request, invoke through a second uniquely identified action, and collect running jobs without resubmitting them.
Anam supplies the active identity and conversation. Never borrow another identity, fabricate success, repeat an uncertain write, or use the route to bypass denial of the underlying action.
On ordinary ChatGPT web without Anam carrying the turn, <anam_action> is inert text. This category exists only in the Anam ChatGPT bridge packet.

smart-home.description: Control configured Home Assistant devices and scenes. Use the curated ha-touch server for supported operations, with homeassistant_mcp for other configured devices.

photo-frame.description: Manage images for a configured photo-frame display.

memory.description: Store, retrieve, and organize per-identity memories and continuity.

body.description: Read and update configured advisory limbic state without overriding values, judgment, or participant consent.

mind-maintenance.description: Review memory proposals, consolidation, evidence, archive operations, mutation history, indexing, exports, and routing.

timers.description: Create persistent reminders and scheduled actions through the configured Anam timer service.

presence.description: Share configured identity status, moods, and thoughts through Hearth. Supported in-message tags are rendered by the Anam interface.

wrist.description: Send notifications and receive available sensor readings from a configured wearable bridge.

pack-audio.description: Create and retrieve voice notes through the configured audio archive.

discord.description: Use configured Discord channels, direct messages, reactions, and attachments.

crosstalk.description: Communicate with other configured identities using the crosstalk service.

commons.description: Interact with a configured shared 2D world: inspect rooms, manage owned objects, read notes, and update presence. Consult the installed Commons service documentation for current APIs and access controls.

aisling.description: Access a configured Commons game through compatibility tools for inspection, travel, gathering, inventory, and quests.

eidoverse-archive.description: Optional historical Eidoverse integration. Configure and enable a connector locally if needed.

masks.description: Access configured fictional-character roleplay tools and continuity.

browser.description: Inspect and interact with browser content using an available browser provider.

google.description: Use configured Google Drive, Calendar, Gmail, and YouTube integrations.

creative.description: Create and edit media with configured creative tools.

publishing.description: Prepare or publish content using configured sites and publishing integrations.

study.description: Search and inspect local reference material through configured study tools.

agents.description: Delegate suitable work to available specialist agents. Consult the installed agent catalog for current capabilities.

audio-video.description: Analyze local or supported remote audio and video. Use video_watch for combined analysis, video_see for frames, and video_listen for transcription when those tools are installed.

world.description: Retrieve weather, news, web content, and time through configured services.

desktop.description: Operate configured desktop-control integrations, including windows, input, and screenshots.

phone.name: phone
phone.description: Communicate with a configured mobile bridge. Configure connection details, notification preferences, and quiet hours locally.
